newsitem.title: USA: American Stone sets reverse split.
newsitem.headline: American Stone sets reverse split.

text.p: American Stone Industries Inc said on Friday that its shareholders have approved a reverse stock split, which was necessary for the company to meet the listing standards on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The reverse split will be one share for up to every 10 shares held, a company spokesman said.
The company said it hopes to file an application to have its shares listed on the Nasdaq by the end of 1996.
The company presently has approximately 16 million shares outstanding.
